contentText:
Maria Armental / Wall Street Journal :

Huskeys, which uses agentic AI to help companies block AI-driven attacks, raised a $27M Series A led by Blackstone Innovations Investments at a $100M+ valuation   —  The company, valued at more than $100 million, uses agentic AI to block threats  —  Blackstone is placing an early bet on Huskeys …
